mechanism_narrative: A sustained low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS below 1.5%) indicates accommodative monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS below 1.5% and 20-day forward returns negative in >60% of instances over any 12-month rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A declining unemployment rate (UNRATE below 4.0%) signals labor market tightness that accelerates inflation expectations, triggering preemptive monetary tightening and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE below 4.0% and 5-day forward returns positive in >60% of cases over next 12 months.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in retail sales (RSAFS above 3-month moving average) and housing starts (HOUST above 3-month moving average) indicates robust consumer spending, driving corporate earnings and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: RSAFS and HOUST both above 3-month moving averages and 60-day forward returns negative in >60% of cases over next 12 months.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansions, high industrial production (INDPRO above 105) signals economic overheating and impending slowdown, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In late-cycle expansions, INDPRO above 105 associated with positive 20-day returns in >60% of cases over past 5 years.

mechanism_narrative: Strong retail sales (RSAFS above 12-month moving average) consistently indicates resilient consumer demand, supporting corporate revenue growth and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: RSAFS above 12-month moving average and 5-day forward returns negative in >60% of observations over past 5 years.

mechanism_narrative: Federal funds rate exceeding 2.0% signals aggressive monetary tightening, increasing discount rates for equity valuation and producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS above 2.0% and 60-day forward returns positive in >60% of cases over next 12 months.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent employment growth (PAYEMS above 3-month moving average) and falling unemployment (UNRATE below 4.5%) indicate labor market overheating, accelerating inflation and triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: PAYEMS above 3-month moving average and UNRATE below 4.5% associated with positive 20-day returns in >60% of cases over next 12 months.

mechanism_narrative: During monetary tightening cycles, rising interest rates compress equity valuations and increase risk aversion, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: During monetary tightening cycles, 60-day forward returns positive in >60% of cases over past 5 years.
